source: The ZXNAME0000XZ paper emphasizes another engineering change: the implementation is written in CuTe-DSL embedded in Python. The paper reports ZXMATH0000XZ faster compile times than the traditional C++ template-based approach used in its comparison while retaining the required low-level expressivity.[7]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 论文强调了另一个工程变化：实现是用嵌入 Python 的 CuTe-DSL 编写的。该论文报告说，ZXMATH0000XZ 的编译时间比比较中使用的传统 C++ 模板方法更快，同时保留了所需的低级表达能力。 [7]
